context: News: Sakura and Ren on a construction-safety drive.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: news report; vocabulary (建設/危険/建築/メーカー/ドア) in natural home.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 建設業界で、安全運動が始まりました。
lines.en: A safety drive began in the construction industry.
lines.style: crisp adult anchor voice, soft warm professional clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 建設現場の危険は、減りますか?
lines.style: measured young reporter voice, soft warm serious focus throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 各メーカーが、危険を減らす工夫をしています。
lines.en: Each maker works to reduce danger.
lines.style: clear adult anchor voice, soft warm serious clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 建築の手順も、見直すんですか?
lines.en: Will construction procedures be reviewed too?
lines.style: serious young reporter voice, soft warm focus throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ええ、建築の各段階を点検します。
lines.en: Yes, each stage of construction is inspected.
lines.style: professional adult anchor voice, soft warm serious clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 小さな部品でも、危険になりますか?
lines.en: Can even small parts become dangerous?
lines.style: thoughtful young reporter voice, soft warm focus throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ドア一枚の取り付けも、慎重に行います。
lines.en: Even installing one door is done carefully.
lines.style: measured adult anchor voice, soft warm serious clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 建設の安全が、守られるといいですね。
lines.en: I hope construction safety is protected.
lines.style: earnest young reporter voice, soft warm calm closing throughout
